result.summary: The page is generally usable, but there are a few visible polish issues: a misspelled search placeholder, clipped horizontal carousel content at the right edge, and partially cut-off cards that may look unintentionally truncated.

issues.description: Search placeholder text is misspelled as “Restarants, dishes, groceries” instead of “Restaurants, dishes, groceries”.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder copy to “Restaurants, dishes, groceries”.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped at the right edge, with the next chip only partially visible and no clear fade or scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add an edge fade, padding, or scroll affordance so clipped chips feel intentional.

issues.description: In “Fastest near you”, the third restaurant card is cut off at the screen edge and its name is truncated as “Trattoria Piccol…”, which can look broken without a visible carousel indicator.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card peeking, ellipsis styling, or a horizontal scroll indicator to make truncation clearly intentional.

issues.description: The lower “Popular right now” card is sliced off at the bottom of the viewport, showing only the top of the pizza image.
issues.suggestion: This is normal for scrollable content, but adding bottom spacing or ensuring the next card peeks consistently can reduce the appearance of accidental cropping.
